scenes.direction_en: On the separate safe altar route, Clem, Vespera and Thistle meet a local guide and lantern carrier. These two ordinary villagers complete the five-person viewing group in the new expansion.
scenes.purpose_tr: Kaynak beş token için iki event-scoped köylü eklenir; Fadyme/Mahmut çağrılmaz.

lines.text_en: The highland road has more footsteps than carts today. People carry wrapped food and small lamps that will not be needed until they come down.
We leave the narrow shelf for anyone coming back. The watchers go up on this side.
Watchers. That sounds more respectable than people looking at the sky.
It sounds shorter when you need them to move.
There is room to rest before the climb?
At the lower terrace. And at the ridge, if you do not crowd its edge.
Then we can see without making someone stand where they should not.
The guide and lantern carrier stay with the three travelers, a small group inside the larger procession.

scenes.direction_en: On their own safe route to the altar, Clem, Vespera and Thistle join highland villagers climbing to watch the far mountain where the eclipse hangs.

lines.text_en: Sun-Eclipse Day. Once a year the villages say the black sun breathes.
Does it?
Every grave-keeper's record says yes. Every scholar's says no. I trust grave-keepers.

scenes.purpose_tr: Canon An Old Holy Day üç satır aynen; sourceafter6-5.

scenes.direction_en: Clem talks about records without disclosing Fadyme secrets. Vespera distinguishes observation from explanations.
scenes.purpose_tr: Metodoloji curiosity; sonraki büyükmekanizmaya kesincevap yok.

lines.text_en: I would like to read the village record after we watch.
Before and after would be better.
You think they will change it?
I think we will ask different questions after seeing something.
And we should choose a place before the crowd fills it.
The open ridge gives a wider view. The terrace gives firmer room behind you.
We can reach either. The first turn needs clearing before the slower walkers come.

scenes.direction_en: Both viewing places see the same source eclipse event. The party clears the first approach before villagers use it.
scenes.purpose_tr: İki rota2encounterve4storyscenede ayrışır; viewpoint sourceeventi değiştirmez.

lines.text_en: The open path lets the far threats reach around. On the terrace path the closest dead press harder.
We can prepare for either. Nobody goes ahead of the clear road.
Choose where we stand. It will not choose what the sky does.

options.consequence_en: Two approach fights emphasize reaching attackers and target priority.

lines.text_en: Wide view. I can write what changed without borrowing someone’s shoulder.
And I will keep a place behind the first row for anyone needing to sit.

options.consequence_en: Two approach fights emphasize steady front pressure and supporting enemies.

lines.text_en: Firm ground, and room to stop. That will help people look without leaning.
A narrower view can still be an honest one.

scenes.direction_en: The villagers wait below the first turn. Enemies are known earlier-chapter dead, not a new eclipse-created species.
scenes.purpose_tr: Ridge B01 önce; gerçek ölü tehdidi pulse nedeniyle yeni üretilmiş sayılmaz.

lines.text_en: Wait below the white stone. We clear the turn before anyone climbs past it.
The one at the back is reaching around the nearest bodies.
Notice the reach. Do not follow it off the firm line.
There is room for the rear to stay together here.
The lantern carrier sets the wrapped lamps down on safe ground.

scenes.direction_en: After the first fight, Clem notes where the view ends. No free-text notebook feature is required.

lines.text_en: I can see the valley mouth, but not the road behind that rise.
Write both. A limit is part of a useful account.
The grave-keepers are less demanding.
The grave-keepers ask which stone you actually saw.
A fair correction. I like this village already.
Thistle checks the firm edge while the group climbs into the cleared turn.

scenes.direction_en: A second visible threat blocks access to the viewing area. The locals stay behind the cleared line.

lines.text_en: The ridge opens beyond this stretch. Nobody climbs round the dead to save time.
The nearest one holds the line. Something behind it is keeping it moving.
Then notice the support and the reach together.
Two things to write down after. One thing to choose first.
The group leaves its waiting space clear before stepping forward.

scenes.direction_en: The small five-person group reaches the ridge. The wider village crowd stays within marked safe viewing room.

lines.text_en: Here. You can see without standing at the edge.
Leave this space for anyone who needs to sit.
The mountain looks closer than it did from the road.
The distance has not changed. Our view has.
That is a good reason to climb. A worse reason to lean.
The lamps remain wrapped. There is enough daylight to see one another’s faces.

scenes.direction_en: The villagers wait at a safe bend. The narrow approach emphasizes front-line pressure.

lines.text_en: This bend stays for waiting. The next stretch stays for the fight.
Two close threats, and a supporting one behind them.
Hold the line where the ground is firm. You do not need to win the whole path at once.
The watchers can see us from below. Let us leave them a clear way up.
The carrier keeps the lamps beside the waiting bench.

scenes.direction_en: After the first fight, the group tests the terrace viewpoint. People can still observe the source event.

lines.text_en: The bench is low enough to sit without blocking anyone’s view.
I see less of the valley from here.
Then write less of the valley. There is no duty to invent the part behind stone.
The people who sat here last year survived with very modest views.
There is more to see when people are not trying to see over one another.
Thistle moves a loose basket out of the walking space, not into the sight line.

scenes.direction_en: The second encounter protects access to the landing; enemies are outside the waiting terrace.

lines.text_en: The upper landing is not clear yet. The terrace remains safe while we make it so.
The support is behind the nearest dead. I can hold while it is chosen.
A steady opening. Keep it rather than chasing the first gap.
Nobody watching needs to join the fight to earn the view.
The group steps toward the landing. The villagers stay seated until the road is open.

scenes.direction_en: The protected landing shares the canonical ridge location. No new event result is attached to the route.

lines.text_en: There. The rim of the black sun is above that shoulder of rock.
I can see it from the bench.
That was the useful part of the plan.
Keep your account at the height of your own eyes.
And your feet on this side of the last stone.
The little group watches with the other villagers. Nobody needs to hold someone else upright to see.

scenes.direction_en: At noon the eclipse's rim flickers. Every bell pin, charm and bell in the valley hums at once.

lines.text_en: The owing-bells are all opening. All of them. The whole ridge.
It is not breathing. It is recounting. Every owed hour in the valley, checked at once.
Why t-today?
Because someone set a day for it. Machines keep calendars. So do chancellors.

scenes.purpose_tr: Canon The Breath dört satır aynen: owingbell/recount/calendar açıklaması kaynak sınırında.

scenes.direction_en: The collective hum has passed. The source phenomenon is not stopped, cleansed or defeated by a battle.

lines.text_en: The humming leaves the air before the crowd remembers how to speak at its usual volume.
I heard mine with the valley’s. I have never heard it like that.
Sit for a moment. You do not have to stand while you find the words.
I will write that the rim flickered and the bells answered together.
And keep the explanation beside it, rather than inside the observation.
We go down in small groups. The road has not become wider because everyone wants it now.

scenes.title_en: What to Keep in the Account
scenes.direction_en: Choose an emphasis for the ordinary local account. Both preserve the source explanation and uncertainty about its authors.

lines.text_en: The guide keeps a record of what the watchers noticed. I can help make today’s useful.
People may remember the sound before they remember the sky.
We need not make all memories look alike.

choice.prompt_en: Choose the emphasis of the account.

options.text_en: Describe the view and its limits.
options.consequence_en: Record the rim and viewpoint; a visual observation callback.

lines.text_en: The rim flickered. I will say where we stood when we saw it.
And where the stone interrupted the view.
That will help the next reader understand what you actually saw.

options.consequence_en: Keep the collective sound and a person’s account; a listening callback.

lines.text_en: We can start with the sound. You do not have to explain the whole valley.
Mine joined the others. That is what I know.
Then that is the line I will keep beside what we saw.

scenes.direction_en: The outer return path has a known supporting-dead threat. The villagers wait at a safe landing; the hum is not a new combat modifier.

lines.text_en: The lower return path is blocked. Wait at the landing until we clear it.
The people behind us have space to rest. Keep that space out of the fight.
A reaching threat and a support. Read both before we move.
We do not need a battle to explain the sky. We do need one to open this road.
The lantern carrier leaves the lamps at the landing. The travelers face the known dead below it.

scenes.direction_en: The cleared road is used by small groups. No timed civilian failure simulation.

lines.text_en: The turn is clear. The first group can go at its own pace.
I can carry the lamps without asking everyone to hurry.
Good. Somebody will still need light lower down.
Let the road decide the pace, rather than the fear.
Clem folds the account away before helping the next watcher stand.

scenes.direction_en: Callback for the visual account. The local record has a viewpoint note; no new codex answer is unlocked.

lines.text_en: You wrote that the rise hid part of the valley.
It did. I was tempted to borrow the wider view from the person beside me.
You may quote them. You may not pretend their eyes were yours.
A demanding village record. I am beginning to approve of it.
The guide leaves room beside Clem’s account for another watcher to add their own.

scenes.title_en: A Sound Kept in Someone’s Words
scenes.direction_en: Callback for listening. The lantern carrier chooses a brief account without revealing a secret identity.

lines.text_en: Will you write that I was frightened?
If that is part you want kept. Or only the sound.
You get to choose your own line.
The sound first. I will decide about the rest later.
Clem writes the short account and reads it back at the carrier’s pace.

scenes.direction_en: The villagers give each traveler a stamped token so the eclipse will "know they watched".

lines.text_en: Sun-Eclipse tokens. Superstition. I am keeping five.
Why five?
One for each of us who watched. So somebody knows we were here.

scenes.purpose_tr: Canon Tokens üç satır aynen. Beşli sourcecümlesine uygun newviewinggroup; token prop only.

scenes.direction_en: Clem has five stamped keepsakes for the three travelers, guide and lantern carrier. They are props, not a new currency or defined reward.

lines.text_en: You have enough for the little group. You may take them.
I did count before keeping five. I am capable of restraint when given clear instructions.
You asked whether there were larger ones.
A separate inquiry.
It will be easier to remember where we stood than what we were afraid of.
I would like both to be remembered honestly.
Clem wraps the five pieces in cloth. None has made the bells quiet or the day’s account complete.

scenes.direction_en: Choose a short closing perspective. Nobody discloses the Part II offer or concludes the calendar’s author.

lines.text_en: The guide folds the village record. The three travelers have a quiet moment before taking their established road again.

choice.prompt_en: Whose view do you keep beside the account?

options.consequence_en: A closing about making room for more than one account.

lines.text_en: The guide did not ask me to write the best account. Only my own.
That is a better record than one with no room left.
I will leave room. Even if the next watcher has dreadful handwriting.
She makes the margin a little wider before folding the page.

options.consequence_en: A closing about a useful limit to an explanation.

lines.text_en: You still have questions.
Yes. I have better boundaries for them now.
I may borrow that phrase.
Borrow the boundaries too.

options.text_en: Thistle and the place to sit.
options.consequence_en: A closing about care while people try to understand.

lines.text_en: They kept asking what the sound meant. I could only give them a place to sit.
They asked more clearly after they sat down.
A useful place is an answer to a useful question.
Thistle checks that the bench is dry before leaving it for the next watcher.

scenes.direction_en: The three resume their existing safe altar route. The locals stay with the village record; no extra story day or reunion.

lines.text_en: Your road continues past the lower terrace. Keep to the firm side when it turns.
And keep the village account. I would like to read it again if I come this way.
It has room for another visit.
Thank you for the place to sit.
And for not asking the sky to become simpler than it was.
The travelers leave on the road they were already taking. Behind them, the village keeps several accounts of one noon.
